name: FLA_SUBLEASE_ACTIVITY_DETAILS
description: FLA_SUBLEASE_ACTIVITY_DETAILS contains the sublease activities with respect to its headlease.

columns.name: SUBLEASE_ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Sublease Activity identifier. This is primary key for the table.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: HEADLEASE_LEASE_ID
columns.description: Lease identifier of the headlease associated to the sublease.

columns.name: HEADLEASE_LEASE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Lease detail identifier of the headlease associated to the sublease.

columns.name: HEADLEASE_ASSET_NUMBER
columns.description: Asset number of the headlease asset associated to the sublease asset.

columns.name: SUBLEASE_LEASE_ID
columns.description: Sublease identifier which is undergoing changes.

columns.name: SUBLEASE_LEASE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Lease detail identifier of the sublease.

columns.name: SUBLEASE_ASSET_NUMBER
columns.description: Sublease asset number which is undergoing changes.

columns.name: SUBLEASE_VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version number of the sublease where the changes are incorporated.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Activity type on the sublease that is significant for the headlease from which the current is subleased. Possible values are Booking, Termination and Expiry.

columns.name: HEADLEASE_VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version number of the headlease when the sublease changes are incorporated.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_DATE
columns.description: Date of the activity on the subleased asset that is significant for the headlease.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
